mkdir ./kernel/boot
cp ${KERNEL} ./kernel/boot/
config kernel="./kernel"

# Files from a kernel image or directory are merged over the base.
vimto exec /bin/cat /vimto-test
stdout ^IRnRnZPbNY$

# Modules are bound to a fixed location, regardless of their location in the image.
vimto exec /bin/cat /lib/modules/1.0.0/vimto-test
stdout ^IRnRnZPbNY$

-- kernel/vimto-test --

IRnRnZPbNY
-- kernel/usr/lib/modules/1.0.0/vimto-test --

IRnRnZPbNY
